chapters.label: Penalties, live
chapters.text: Kyiv, 2012. Italy and England go to penalties, and England lead. Andrea Pirlo steps up. The keeper jumps around on his line. Pirlo stays calm... and chips it down the middle. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Pirlo waits for the keeper to move. The keeper dives, and the ball floats gently into the middle.

chapters.label: From behind the net
chapters.text: From behind the net: the keeper is already on the ground. Italy go on to win the shootout!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Under pressure, stay calm and watch the keeper. A calm mind makes good decisions.
